title: 第11章 曾经晰月城第一天才一定会强势归来第12章 绝刃剑子良星尘
lines: 晰月城！
在一片混乱中，城中的居民被惊扰。
“发生什么事了？怎么我刚才看到城门都被封锁了？”
“你还不知道吧？出大事了。”
“什么大事？”
“萧家的小主，被杀了。”
“嘶？怎么回事？被谁杀的？”
“还能有谁？萧家弃子，萧诺。
我听说，一起被杀的还有天罡剑宗的一位内门弟子。”
“天，这下不得了，天罡剑宗还不震怒啊？”
“等不到天罡剑宗的怒火来袭了，今天晚上萧家就要把那萧家弃子抽骨扒皮。”
晰月城的大街小巷内，萧家的守卫队伍就像龙舟般迅速的来回穿梭。
哪怕是漆黑的小道，都有人在举着火把到处搜寻。
西城门。
“你们都睁大眼睛盯好了，家主有令，今晚就算是掘地三尺，也要把杀人凶手揪出来。”
“各个城门都给我看紧了，绝对不能让他逃了去。”
距离西城门大约五百米处的一座阁楼背侧，萧诺小心翼翼的退回了黑暗当中。
不得不说，萧家的动作真是够快，在第一时间就把所有的城门都封锁了。
虽然在击杀李流，萧永后，萧诺第一时间就打算离开晰月城，但两条腿又岂能跑得过四条腿？
萧家豢养了不少的灵兽灵马，萧雄立即就令人骑着灵马，驾驭着灵兽封锁了出城的道路。
“看来只能强行杀出去了……”
萧诺眼角一闪凛光，就在其按着身后的刀柄，准备直奔西城门的时候，一只手突然搭上了萧诺的肩膀……
萧诺心弦一紧，身形一转，就欲出刀。
“萧诺兄弟，是我！”
对方连忙沉声道。
暗星魂的刀锋照亮了一张中年面孔，萧诺有些诧异的看着对方：“怎么会是你？”
来人竟然是两天前万羽楼同萧诺交易《飞影剑诀》的严管事。
“好险！”
严管事看着萧诺手中的魔刀，稍稍擦了下额头上的冷汗，这要是萧诺没收住刀，自己怕是要血溅当场不可。
萧诺警觉的看着对方：“你来干什么？”
严管事做了个小声的手势：“有人来了，先同我离开。”
说罢，严管事就转身遁入黑暗中。
萧诺眉头轻皱，自己跟对方不过一面之缘，对方有何目的？
content_en:
Xiyue City!
In the chaos, the residents of the city were disturbed.
"What happened? Why did I just see that the city gates were blocked?"
"You don't know yet, right? Something big happened."
"What's the big deal?"
"The young master of the Xiao family was killed."
"Hiss? What happened? Who killed him?"
"Who else could it be? The abandoned son of the Xiao family, Xiao Nuo.
I heard that an inner disciple of the Tiangang Sword Sect was also killed. "
"Oh my God, this is so serious. Isn't the Tiangang Sword Sect angry?"
"Until the wrath of the Tiangang Sword Sect comes, the Xiao family will extract the bones and skin of the abandoned son of the Xiao family tonight."
"..."
In the streets and alleys of Xiyue City, the Xiao family's guard team shuttled back and forth as quickly as a dragon boat.
Even in the dark alley, there are people searching everywhere with torches.
West gate.
"You all keep your eyes peeled. The master of the house has ordered us to dig out the murderer tonight even if we have to dig three feet into the ground."
"Yes!"
"I have guarded all the city gates, and I must not let him escape."
"..."
On the back side of an attic about five hundred meters away from the west city gate, Xiao Nuo carefully retreated into the darkness.
It has to be said that the Xiao family acted very quickly and sealed all the city gates immediately.
Although Xiao Nuo immediately planned to leave Xiyue City after killing Li Liu and Xiao Yong, how could two legs outrun four?
The Xiao family raised a lot of spirit beasts and horses. Xiao Xiong immediately ordered people to ride the spirit horses and control the spirit beasts to block the road out of the city.
"It seems we can only force our way out..."
Xiao Nuo's eyes flashed, and just when he was pressing the hilt of the knife behind him and preparing to go straight to the west city gate, a hand suddenly touched Xiao Nuo's shoulder...
"Huh?"
Xiao Nuo's heartstrings tightened, and he turned around, ready to draw the sword.
"Brother Xiao Nuo, it's me!"
The other party quickly said in a deep voice.
"Qiang!"
Dark Star Soul's blade illuminated a middle-aged face, and Xiao Nuo looked at him in surprise: "How could it be you?"
The person who came turned out to be the manager Yan who had traded "Flying Shadow Sword Art" with Xiao Nuo two days ago.
"What a risk!"
Manager Yan looked at the magic knife in Xiao Nuo's hand and wiped the cold sweat from his forehead. If Xiao Nuo didn't hold the knife, he would probably get blood splattered on the spot.
Xiao Nuo looked at the other party alertly: "What are you doing here?"
"Shh!"
Yan Guanshi made a low-pitched gesture: "Someone is coming, please leave with me first."
After saying that, Yan Guanshi turned around and fled into the darkness.
Xiao Nuo frowned slightly. He and the other party only met each other once. What was the other party's purpose?
title_en: Chapter 11 The once number one genius in Xiyue City will definitely come back strong Chapter 12 The ultimate sword Ziliang Xingchen
